claim: Trying the sample does not change a visitor's real route data.
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed a real draft, edit and reset /demo/, then confirm the real draft is unchanged

claim: Route files, coordinates, notes, export, and validation are processed in the browser.
sandbox: /demo/; edit, export, and validate while recording every outgoing request

claim: The tool does not calculate or silently change an imported route.
sandbox: /demo/; import a non-monotonic three-point GPX and assert exported point order is identical

claim: The tool does not fetch live maps, traffic, location, or safety data.
sandbox: /demo/; instrument location and outgoing requests while selecting a point

claim: Imports GPX track and route geometry, including self-closing point elements.
sandbox: /demo/; import a two-point GPX route with self-closing elements and inspect populated output

claim: Route points can be selected with pointer, touch, and keyboard input.
sandbox: fresh touch-capable /demo/ context; tap the route, then use arrow and Enter keys

claim: Exports intent notes as GPX waypoints with point and line lock metadata.
sandbox: /demo/; parse the downloaded GPX and inspect waypoint descriptions and namespaced lock values

claim: Checks locked places and both directions of a locked line.
sandbox: /demo/; validate a route with original vertices plus a distant detour and require failure
/demo/; parse the downloaded file and assert GPX namespace, version, and all sample track points

claim: Checks a returned route with an adjustable 20–250 metre corridor.
sandbox: /demo/; the same nearby route must fail at 20 metres and pass at 250 metres

claim: The real draft is saved in browser storage and restored after reload.
sandbox: enter real mode from /demo/, import and rename a route, reload, and inspect the restored real draft

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and inspect sample data

claim: GPX import, export, and route checks work without an account, purchase, or license.
sandbox: /demo/ with no license storage; export and validate the sample successfully

claim: The app has no analytics or advertising requests.
sandbox: /demo/; instrument beacons and record requests during an edit

claim: The app makes no map-tile requests.
sandbox: /demo/; record requests while selecting, exporting, and checking a route

claim: Runtime scripts, styles, images, and fonts load only from the product origin.
sandbox: fresh home page; inspect every script, stylesheet, image, and font request

claim: The billing API is contacted only after a visitor provides a license.
sandbox: start at /demo/, enter real mode, mock the billing API, and count requests before and after license submission

claim: An existing valid license enables local named workspaces and four note templates.
sandbox: enter real mode from /demo/, mock valid verification, apply a template, and inspect the saved local workspace
